v2-61.candidate: So consider it from generation to generation: all who hope in Him will not grow weak.
v2-61.close: So consider it from generation to generation: all who hope in Him will not fail.
v2-61.display:
So consider it from generation to generation:
all who hope in Him will not grow weak.

v2-7.display:
and said, “Alas for me!
Why was I born to see the ruin of my people
and the ruin of the holy city,
and to sit there while she was given into the hand of enemies,
the sanctuary into the hand of foreigners?

v2-10.display:
What nation has not taken possession of her royal places
and seized her spoils?

v2-12.display:
Behold! Our holy places, our beauty, and our glory have been laid waste,
and the nations have profaned them.

v2-62.display:
Do not fear the words of a sinful man,
for his glory will become dung and worms.

v2-63.display:
Today he shall be exalted,
and tomorrow he shall not be found,
for he has returned to his dust,
and his thought shall perish.
